content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":false,"reason":"Electric power generation and telecom services to remote Alaska communities; no natural gas or propane distribution."},{"label":"C2","good":false,"reason":"Regulated water and wastewater utility; different product and asset base from gas and propane."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Mainly an electric generation and transmission utility with secondary gas; no propane distribution."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Regulated natural gas distribution plus propane delivery to homes and businesses, closely matching the target's two lines."},{"label":"C5","good":false,"reason":"Primarily electric and steam delivery in New York City; gas is secondary and the business is mostly electric."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Propane distribution by delivery to homes and businesses with appliance service; matches the target's propane line, though it lacks regulated gas."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Water and wastewater utility with municipal contract operations; different product and customer base."},{"label":"C8","good":true,"reason":"Regulated residential and commercial natural gas distribution with appliance service plans, matching the target's core gas utility business."},{"label":"C9","good":true,"reason":"Pure regulated natural gas distribution to residential and business customers, matching the target's gas utility business."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Crude oil refining and wholesale and retail motor fuel; a different business from gas distribution and propane delivery."},{"label":"C11","good":true,"reason":"Propane delivery by truck to residential and commercial tank customers with tank and equipment service, matching the target's propane line."},{"label":"C12","good":false,"reason":"Primarily electricity generation and transmission in New Mexico and Texas; gas distribution is secondary and no propane."}]}
